thread:
maria-cs: quick heads-up — BluePeak renewal in 3 weeks. they flagged a 3x latency spike last Tue and want SLO evidence + credit calc for the week. can we pull a compact readout by EOD? :alarm_clock:
ashwin-ops: got it. looking at infra — 99.6% uptime for the week but p50 latency jumped from 120ms -> 380ms for their prod route on 2025-11-11 14:02–14:18 UTC. possible KV-cache evictions. linking dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/bluepeak/slo
jordan-ps: for comms, CS wants a short paragraph + one-slide graph. do we have a suggested phrasing for the credit ask so finance/sales can review?
leo-sre: quick note — there was a deploy that rolled a model variant at 14:00 and a routing fallback at 14:15. logs show repeated OOM traces then more CPU contention on the worker pool. rough remediation: revert canary on that route and increase kv-cache size + enable autoscale buffer to avoid throttles.
maria-cs: can someone dump the evidence bundle (uptime table + per-route p50/p95 + traces) and attach it here? customer needs numbers + top 3 root causes. also need an estimated credit impact.
nashwin-ops: generating bundle now. run command: ```./tools/slo-bundle --account bluepeak --range 2025-11-04..2025-11-11 --output bluepeak-evidence.zip``` will include tokenized cost estimates; ETA ~20m.
leo-sre: adding a concise incident summary for the bundle: "14:00 model variant rollout triggered cache pressure; fallback routing increased load on smaller workers; result: higher tail latency for ~18 minutes. Mitigations: canary revert, cache increase, autoscale buffer; follow-up: tune kernel selection for this model family."
jordan-ps: suggested customer-friendly phrasing for CS email: "We observed a transient latency regression on your prod route from 14:02–14:18 UTC on Nov 11. Our team identified the root cause and implemented mitigations. Based on our SLO windows, your account crosses the latency threshold for that week and is eligible for a pro-rated credit of ~$2,300. Full evidence bundle attached and happy to review on a 20-min call." sound ok? :white_check_mark:
maria-cs: that works. please include the p50/p95 table and the trace IDs. i'll prep the email draft and coordinate with sales for the credit signoff.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-11-11_13:59:47 by @release-ci passed: canary->primary (route: bluepeak-prod) :rocket:
ashwin-ops: bundle uploaded to https://s3.redwood.ai/bluepeak-evidence/bluepeak-evidence-1751234567.zip — includes metrics.csv, traces.json (top 10 trace ids), uptime.csv, and credit_calc.md. I ran the credit calc with our standard formula, provisional credit: "\$2300".
leo-sre: one quick ask for postmortem — capture the kernel selection telemetry + cache miss rates in the follow-up so we can recommend quantization/kit changes for next rollout.
maria-cs: thanks everyone. i'll send the draft to @sales-ops and loop in legal for the credit. ping me for the 1:1 review before i hit send. :pray:
